meta.title: RestoMenu — Digital Menus, Live on Your TVs
meta.description: Manage your restaurant's digital menus from your phone and broadcast them to every TV in real time.

hero.subtitle: Stop wasting time and money on static menu boards. Update your dishes from your phone and see them appear on every TV — instantly.

problem.title: Stop Wasting Money and Time on Static Menus
problem.description: Every time you change a price or add a dish, you waste hours designing a new image, exporting it, and uploading it to your screens. Static boards make your restaurant look outdated and cost you sales from missed daily specials.
